description: Amtrak Real Estate Properties in Oppurtunity Zones - Industrial, Office and Commercial is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by USDOT. This data set shows Amtrak industrial, office, and commercial real estate in opportunity zones. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 7 columns, among them US States, Property Type, New Georeferenced Column, State, Street Address, City. The portal shows 2019-08-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: USDOT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
